_note: Level 1 of the computer opponent (spec 10.1): pots about 35% of medium shots and 10% of long ones, breaks under 10, rarely plays safe, mostly centre ball. 'values' is what is loaded; 'docs' gives each value's unit, source and note. Starting values until the tournament tunes them.

tier.note: 1 to 5 on the ladder; 0 for the 147, which is outside it.

aim_sigma_rad.source: ours, tuned to spec 10.1 by ofs_sim_cli tournament
aim_sigma_rad.note: Standard deviation of the aim on a short straight pot with nothing in the way.

aim_sigma_per_cut.note: The aim's sigma grows by this fraction per radian of cut.

aim_sigma_per_m.note: The aim's sigma grows by this fraction per metre the cue ball travels to its ball.

awkward_factor.note: The aim's sigma is multiplied by this when cueing is hampered or the cue raised.

speed_sigma.note: Standard deviation of the cue speed, as a fraction of the speed meant.

tip_sigma.note: Standard deviation of each tip offset.

max_cut_rad.note: It does not consider a pot with a wider cut.

max_tip.note: The largest tip offset it plays on purpose; 0 is centre ball only.

speeds.note: Cue speeds it tries for a pot.

spins.note: Tip offsets it tries for a pot; the first is centre ball.

depth.note: Strokes it plans beyond this one, each simulated; 0 reads the leave only.

position_weight.note: How much the position left counts beside the pot itself.

judgement_sigma.note: The error in its own reading of a pot's chance (spec 10.3: lower levels choose worse).

safety_below.note: It plays safe when its best pot's chance, as it reads it, is under this.

max_sims.source: ours, from the think time of spec 10.6
max_sims.note: Simulations it may run for one stroke.

maximum.note: It plays for a maximum break and nothing else (spec 10.1).
